objective.title: Qualify versioned Math NuGet archives and independent local consumers

declared.summary: Qualify seven versioned local net10 Math archives with an independent bounded ZIP/nuspec audit, real SHA-256, embedded distribution README/NOTICE and a clean pinned NuGet consumer. Require a compiled missing-API RED, 40 GREEN tests, eight package-only probes, the retained eight-probe exact console and seven inspected archives. declared.value: Make independently consumable Math packages verifiable from actual local archive bytes, declared dependency versions, documented notices and isolated NuGet restores. Do not confuse a net10 target with cross-platform certification or a local preview with public publication.

Repack seven real local archives, inspect nuspec graph, readme/notice and SHA-256 independently, then compare all digests against a separate clean NuGet-only consumer.
Restore the new eight-probe consumer and rerun the existing exact eight-probe console using only the pinned local distribution preview.3 without source ProjectReference or external feeds.
Run locked Release compilation, focused distribution tests, relevant prior Math component regressions, native DWF and planning checks with proportional validation.
Record actual SDK/RID without certifying other OSs, public CI, stable NuGet, binary ABI, license choice or cross-platform support; leave C02-T2 and release gates open.
